name: God Hates Liars
overview: God's hatred for lying is clearly revealed in Scripture, where falsehood is described as an abomination to Him (Proverbs 12:22) and a cause of shame for the wicked (Proverbs 13:5). The commandment against bearing false witness underscores the seriousness of truthfulness in our relationships (Exodus 20:16). Jesus identifies Himself as the embodiment of truth (John 14:6), calling believers to abide in His word and live as genuine disciples (John 8:31), highlighting that honesty is integral to the Christian walk.
